notes: The prompt says simulator, which normally lands on Simulation, but the answers plainly contradict that reading - no herd, survival, breeding or taming, just free roaming as a horse - and none of Simulation's presets describe a game with no plot, no task loop and no upgrade economy, so I overrode the self-declared word and filed it as Roleplay & Avatar Sim's Animal Sim. That is the genre's stated rule for animal sims: no town, so wilderness-open with a natural shelter rather than any settlement shape. Added terrain-relief on top of the preset because the answers made natural landform the map's boundary, and Yellowstone's canyons and ridges are what the player is there to see, which costs the tiered elevation pass but no overhangs. I decided without asking that there is no end to reach - a free-roam range has no finish, so no gate or winner zone - and left water out since neither the prompt nor the answers asked for rivers or lakes, keeping the build off CHECK.
